subject: Week0 launch canvas + eval playbook — initial doc & asks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helix.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Week0 launch canvas + eval playbook — initial doc & asks

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I sketched a lightweight Week0 launch canvas and an initial evaluation playbook to help Helix get a fast, measurable onramp. Attached are the stub docs (week0-onramp-template.gdoc + eval-playbook-outline.pdf). I pushed a live copy here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wk0-onramp-stub — you should be able to comment.

High-level asks / proposed Week0 agenda (60–90m):
- Confirm stakeholders & technical owners (see table in doc)
- Quick environment check: test dataset access, sample inference traffic, and network egress rules
- Acceptance criteria: sample latency & throughput targets, and success signals for QA
- Security checkpoints: list of required evidence and who will accept it
- Next steps & 30/60/90 milestone windows

Proposed owners (initial):
- Technical lead: Samir Patel (Helix)
- Integration owner: Jasmine Liu (Redwood)
- Program manager: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Commercial owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood)

Target timeline: this initial plan assumes a 30-day evaluation to a pilot acceptance, with a fast-path option if Helix can provide test data and a security contact quickly. If you prefer a longer runway we can expand to 6 weeks — open to what works for you.

Can you confirm:
1) Who should be on the Week0 call? (names + emails)
2) Any mandatory procurement or security gating we should plan for now?
3) Whether we can get a sample dataset / API key for sandbox access by next Wed?

Attachments: week0-onramp-template.gdoc, eval-playbook-outline.pdf

Thanks — happy to iterate the doc live during the call.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helix.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helix.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week0 launch canvas + eval playbook — initial doc & asks

Vivek —

Appreciate the clean outline. We like the structure and a Week0 sync makes sense. Confirming the Helix attendees: me (Elena), Samir (tech lead), Priya Narang (security), and our EA Will Chen (scheduling).

Two items up front:
- Security / procurement: our security team requires a short SOC2 evidence review and a data-processing addendum before we can provision sandbox keys. That usually adds ~2 weeks.
- Timeline: given the SOC2 checkpoint, we would prefer a 6-week evaluation window to give our SREs time to validate throughput under a representative dataset. If Redwood can provide a pre-populated security-evidence-summary.pdf (high-level), that will accelerate our internal review.

If we accept the Week0 agenda, can Jasmine or Marissa cover the integration owner walk-through and show where the acceptance criteria will live? Also please confirm any network/IP allowlist requirements so our infra team can carve the right rules.

Quote: 
> High-level asks / proposed Week0 agenda (60–90m):
> - Confirm stakeholders & technical owners (see table in doc)
> - Quick environment check: test dataset access, sample inference traffic, and network egress rules
> - Acceptance criteria: sample latency & throughput targets, and success signals for QA
> - Security checkpoints: list of required evidence and who will accept it
> - Next steps & 30/60/90 milestone windows

Thanks — we can do the Week0 call next Tue AM Pacific if that works for Redwood.

Best,
Elena
Head of Product | Helix AI
elena.gomez@helix.ai
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helix.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week0 launch canvas + eval playbook — initial doc & asks

Thanks Elena — this is helpful context. Vivek, I updated the live Week0 doc with a security checklist section and added a one-page security-evidence-summary.pdf stub (attached). The doc now has a small table to capture which acceptance criteria are owner-validated vs. automated tests.

Proposal to accommodate Helix timing:
- Move to a 6-week evaluation cadence as requested.
- Week0: kickoff + access provisioning (owners confirm)
- Week2: baseline perf run (sample dataset) + quick regression tests
- Week4: full-throughput soak + guardrail checks
- Week6: acceptance review and pilot sign-off

Owner notes:
- I will run the integration walkthrough on Week0 and own the integration checklist items through Week2.
- Marissa will coordinate acceptance criteria and success signals across product and QA.
- Ben will lead any benchmarking artifacts and runbooks we hand to Helix.

Attachments included: security-evidence-summary.pdf, week0-owners-sheet.xlsx (owners + contact column). I also updated the Google Doc at https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wk0-onramp-stub — please comment directly on the acceptance criteria table.

If Helix can send the SOC2 artifact pointer or typical auditor contact, we can align Marissa and our security team to reduce the gating time.

On the call timing — Tue AM Pacific works for us. Vivek, can you propose two 60–75m slots and I'll lock one.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week0 launch canvas + eval playbook — initial doc & asks

All — great. Thanks for the quick alignment. I updated the HubSpot deal with the 6-week cadence and uploaded Jasmine's security stub to the deal record (link in metadata). Proposed slots for Week0:
- Tue 2026-09-29 09:00–10:15 PT
- Tue 2026-09-29 11:30–12:45 PT

Elena — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm the preferred slot and stakeholder list. In the meantime, pushing the attachments to the shared Drive folder and tagging Marissa to start the acceptance criteria doc.

Next actions:
1) Elena to confirm attendees + preferred Tue slot
2) Helix to share SOC2 pointer or procurement contact (Priya)
3) Redwood to provide sandbox key instructions and allowlist IPs prior to Week0

Thanks — looking forward to getting Week0 on the calendar.
